steps.body:
Meeting a part is only half the work.

Jung called the next step 'Education' — not schooling, but bringing what you understood down into how you actually live. Insight that stays in imagination doesn't transform behavior. It needs a point of contact with reality.

This is that point.

steps.title: What came up in your last meeting — or in recent work?
steps.body: A part, a quality, something you recognized. Briefly. Just enough to locate yourself.

steps.title: What's one thing you can do differently this week?
steps.body: Not a transformation. One moment, one relationship, one choice where this insight gets to live.

steps.title: What's the most likely way this doesn't happen?
steps.body: Naming the obstacle isn't pessimism — it's preparation.
steps.placeholder: What will pull you back toward the familiar…

exit.body: Your intention is saved in the Integration tab. The distance between insight and living it closes one act at a time.
